variants.label: Orbit
variants.description: A bright trail circles twelve dots.

variants.label: Ripple
variants.description: An expanding wave pushes the matrix outward.

variants.label: Cascade
variants.description: Short columns rain down in staggered bursts.

variants.label: Wave
variants.description: Five dots ride a travelling sine wave.

variants.label: Pulse
variants.description: A diamond of tiles expands and contracts as one.

variants.label: Braid
variants.description: Two strands cross over and under each other.

variants.label: Comet
variants.description: A sharp tail chases the square perimeter.

variants.label: Bounce
variants.description: Three dots jump and squash on landing.

variants.label: Equalizer
variants.description: Five bars stretch in syncopated beats.

variants.label: Flip
variants.description: Four tiles turn edge-on, then open again.

variants.label: Scan
variants.description: A three-dot beam sweeps from side to side.

variants.label: Quad swap
variants.description: Four tiles trade corners around a 2×2 grid.

variants.label: Quad fold
variants.description: A 2×2 grid folds into the centre and opens.

variants.label: Tic tac
variants.description: A 3×3 grid lights up one row at a time.

variants.label: Bloom
variants.description: Nine dots burst outward from a 3×3 grid.

variants.label: Checker
variants.description: Alternating tiles turn across a 4×4 checkerboard.

variants.label: Diagonal
variants.description: A wave zips diagonally through a 4×4 grid.

variants.label: Triangle
variants.description: A trail climbs and descends ten triangular tiles.

variants.label: Square
variants.description: A hollow square of twelve tiles expands and contracts.

variants.label: Rings
variants.description: Two concentric dotted circles run in opposite directions.

variants.label: Hex
variants.description: Nineteen hexagonal cells swell in a honeycomb wave.

variants.label: Ring
variants.description: The classic rotating arc.

sounds.name: tap
sounds.description: A light knock of wood, for an everyday press.

sounds.name: press
sounds.description: A fuller, lower knock with an octave above, for the main action.

sounds.name: thud
sounds.description: A heavy, damped drop, for an action that can't be taken back.

sounds.name: tick
sounds.description: A tiny, glassy tick, light enough for every row and link.
sounds.usedBy: Menu items, links, sidebar and navigation items, link buttons

sounds.name: copy
sounds.description: Two bright blips a fifth apart: it's on the clipboard.

sounds.name: check
sounds.description: Two clicks stepping up, the way a check mark is drawn.

sounds.name: uncheck
sounds.description: One soft click sliding down, for a box being cleared.

sounds.name: pick
sounds.description: A click that rings on, for one choice taken from a set.
sounds.usedBy: Radios, select and combobox options, command items, calendar days

sounds.name: toggle-on
sounds.description: A soft, round drop as the thumb settles on.

sounds.name: toggle-off
sounds.description: A quieter, shorter sigh as it lets go.

sounds.name: latch
sounds.description: A key pressing in, then catching: click, clack.

sounds.name: unlatch
sounds.description: The key springing back up: one lower click that lifts.

sounds.name: note
sounds.description: A small bell per tab: each position rings the next note of a chord.

sounds.name: page
sounds.description: A paper flick, for turning to another page or month.

sounds.name: whisk
sounds.description: A soft rush of air, for content sliding past.

sounds.name: pop
sounds.description: A quick rising bubble, for a small surface appearing.
sounds.usedBy: Menus, popovers, select and combobox lists, hover cards

sounds.name: dismiss
sounds.description: The bubble falling back, quieter.
sounds.usedBy: Menus, popovers, select and combobox lists, hover cards

sounds.name: open
sounds.description: Two warm notes a fifth apart blooming in, for a dialog.

sounds.name: close
sounds.description: The same fifth stepping down and away.
sounds.usedBy: Dialogs, alert dialogs, command palettes, Search

sounds.name: alert
sounds.description: A minor third with a knock in front: this one needs an answer.

sounds.name: slide-in
sounds.description: Air rising under a low note, for a panel sliding in.

sounds.name: slide-out
sounds.description: The air falling away again.

sounds.name: expand
sounds.description: A short upward unfold, for content opening in place.

sounds.name: collapse
sounds.description: The unfold in reverse, a little quieter.

sounds.name: notify
sounds.description: Two bell tones a fifth apart, for news arriving.

sounds.name: success
sounds.description: A quick rising major chord, for something done.

sounds.name: warning
sounds.description: Two even, reedy pulses on one note: look at this.

sounds.name: error
sounds.description: Two low, buzzing notes falling a third: something failed.

sounds.name: notch
sounds.description: A tiny detent that follows the value, light enough to repeat along a drag.

sounds.name: grab
sounds.description: A low catch, for picking something up.

sounds.name: drop
sounds.description: A soft landing, for letting it go.

sounds.name: deny
sounds.description: Two low knocks, "uh-uh": short enough not to scold.
